# aws-iam-policy-splitter_data_source (Data Source)

Takes a list of IAM policy JSON strings and splits them into bins using a best-fit decreasing bin packing algorithm. Useful for distributing policies across IAM roles while respecting AWS size limits.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `json_policies` (List of String) List of IAM policy JSON strings to split across bins

### Optional

- `bin_size` (Number) Maximum total character length per bin (default: 6144)
- `max_bins` (Number) Maximum number of bins to distribute policies into (default: 10)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source instance
- `policy_bins` (Attributes List) Result of bin packing: a list of bins, each containing a list of IAM policy JSON strings (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policy_bins))

<a id="nestedatt--policy_bins"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policy_bins`

Read-Only:

- `policies` (List of String) List of IAM policy JSON strings assigned to this bin
